verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show phone number provisioning (own Twilio numbers, number porting, inbound number creation) and both outbound (dispatch calls, batch calls) and inbound call handling via the API/pathways, with SIP and webhook integrations rounding out the telephony story. Missing for 10: an explicit standalone REST API reference/OpenAPI spec (probe shows openapi.json 404) and independent third-party confirmation of API call provisioning beyond docs.
